findings.title: Direct post-link unbound/unmapped cell census is absent
findings.evidence: The Tcl labels get_mismatch_objects -repair_status not_repaired as unresolved_reference_count, but contains no get_cells is_unbound/is_unmapped query. Installed ICC2 documentation defines those attributes separately. This leaves the exact M2111-P0-03 reference-completeness repair unimplemented.
findings.minimum_fix: Under a fresh identity, directly query post-link is_unbound and is_unmapped cell collections (and black-box state if applicable), require each count zero, record separate machine facts, parse them, and add nonzero negative tests. Preserve explicit accepted and other mismatch-state queries.

findings.title: Generated report inventory and metric cross-check are incomplete
findings.evidence: The parser omits design_library.rpt, final_design.rpt, and vectorless_power_diagnostic.rpt. A fixture missing all three passes. A timing_setup.rpt reporting slack (VIOLATED) -999.000 also passes while machine_facts remains positive.
findings.minimum_fix: Require the full generated report set and cross-check setup/hold WNS plus routed area/cell census against anchored report text or a separately emitted machine-readable post-route metric report; add omission and contradiction tests.

decision.reason: The contract requires score >=95 and P0/P1/P2=0/0/0; M2122 found 1/0/1.
decision.required_next_action: Leave M2121 immutable, repair both findings under a fresh source identity, and obtain a new independent source hammer before any EDA or license query.
